name: Raw Unrolled Tips Multipack
description: RAW Original Tips are meticulously crafted from natural long fibers using an original type Fourdrinier paper machine – we’ve spared no expense. RAW Original Tips roll up smooth and have enough structural integrity to maintain their shape and rigidity even when wet.
